id.description: A unique identifier used by {@link ArtifactHub} to identify the correct resource.

pkgName.description: The name of the package that the resource belongs to.

path.description: The path of the file, which will be used to write the content of the resource.

category.description: The category that the resource belongs to.

artifact.description: The {@link ArtifactHub.Artifact} this resource is associated with.

displayName.description: The display name for the resource.

description.description: A brief description to attach to the resource.

iconPath.description:
The relative path from the resource to the icon to display (e.g. `img/icon.png` where the `img` folder
is inside the `doc` folder of `rootPkgName/src/doc/rootPkgName.c3doc.md`).

title: {@link ArtifactHub} type used to distribute and receive resources efficiently.
name: ArtifactHub.Artifact.Resource
